task: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. A BibTeX file with two entries is at /home/user/Documents/citations.bib. Launch Zotero. Import /home/user/Documents/citations.bib into the library. After import, both entries must appear in the library as new items: one titled 'LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models' and one titled 'PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways'. Leave Zotero running.

cli_feasibility.reason: CLI-Anything supports importing BibTeX files via the 'import file' command. This uses Zotero's connector endpoint and requires Zotero to be running. The import will create new items from the BibTeX entries.
